description: Return the deterministic projection, including state machine, phase, effect, conflict, and opaque-region data.
name: explain_projection
safety: Read-only. The projection is explanatory; deterministic policy artifacts remain the source of truth.
when_to_use: Use before editing when you need to understand what a policy model currently does.

description: Return persisted simulation scenarios when present, otherwise explicit fixture evidence linked to projection node ids and the current artifact hash.
name: simulate_policy
safety: Read-only. Simulation evidence explains behavior but does not prove every possible input.
when_to_use: Use to compare the user's intended behavior with the behavior Wardwright can demonstrate.

description: List built-in and local workspace Dune policy snippets with source, example inputs, phases, and the structured primitives they may replace.
name: list_dune_snippets
safety: Read-only. Dune snippets are local/trusted policy candidates, not hostile-code portability guarantees.
when_to_use: Use when exploring whether a policy behavior is clearer as inspectable BEAM-native code than as structured primitive fields.

description: Run a registry or ad hoc Dune snippet against a supplied JSON-like input map and return normalized policy-result evidence.
name: evaluate_dune_snippet
safety: Read-only evaluation. Sandbox errors and malformed results fail closed; never activate snippets without scenario review.
when_to_use: Use before proposing any Dune-backed behavior so the user can inspect concrete results and failure modes.

description: Persist a local trusted Dune snippet in the workspace catalog so later policies can reference it by snippet_id.
name: save_dune_snippet
safety: Write-capable. Built-in snippets are read-only; saved snippets are trusted local code and should be reviewed before activation.
when_to_use: Use after evaluating an ad hoc snippet and getting user approval to keep it as a reusable local behavior.

description: Remove a local trusted Dune snippet from the workspace catalog.
name: delete_dune_snippet
safety: Write-capable. Built-in snippets cannot be deleted; existing policies that reference the removed snippet will fail closed.
when_to_use: Use when a workspace snippet is obsolete, misleading, or should no longer be referenced by new policies.

description: Build and validate a draft Wardwright model artifact from supplied provider/model targets, route graph nodes, governance rules, and stream rules without activating it.
name: draft_wardwright_model
safety: Draft-only. This does not change the model served by /v1/chat/completions.
when_to_use: Use when creating a new local Wardwright model or normalizing a hand-written artifact before review.

description: Validate and activate a Wardwright model artifact as a registered local model so agents can call it through the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
name: activate_wardwright_model
safety: Write-capable. Requires protected local access and registers or updates one local model without replacing other active models.
when_to_use: Use only after the user has reviewed the draft, validation output, and relevant simulations.

description: Return a draft artifact with an appended, replaced, or removed governance or stream rule; never applies the proposal.
name: propose_rule_change
safety: Draft-only. Never applies changes; follow with validation/simulation and explicit activation if desired.
when_to_use: Use for small edits to existing governance or stream rules when the user wants a reviewable diff-shaped artifact.

description: Persist a user/chat response pair, fixture, or live-replay scenario so simulations can use reviewed scenario records instead of demo fixtures.
name: record_scenario
safety: Write-capable. Prefer redacted raw turns unless the user explicitly wants sensitive text retained; include model_id and artifact_hash when known.
when_to_use: Use when the user identifies a representative case that should remain visible in the simulator or regression pack.

description: Remove one persisted simulator test case from the workbench scenario library.
name: delete_scenario
safety: Write-capable. Deletes one scenario record; pinned records are not protected from explicit deletion.
when_to_use: Use when a user or authoring agent replaces a stale canned turn with a better reviewed case.

description: Import an existing receipt as a pinned live-replay scenario for later simulation evidence and regression export.
name: import_receipt_scenario
safety: Write-capable. Imported receipts may contain sensitive metadata; review before sharing exported packs.
when_to_use: Use after a real run exposes behavior worth preserving as review evidence.

description: Replay the policy and route decisions recorded in an existing receipt without making any provider call.
name: replay_receipt_policy
safety: Read-only. Replay uses metadata-only VCR fields when present and never returns raw prompts or completions.
when_to_use: Use after importing or inspecting a receipt when you need deterministic control-layer evidence before drafting a policy change.

description: List available agent harness adapters, their import/export commands, and the fidelity limits that prevent claiming equivalent agent resume.
name: list_harness_adapters
safety: Read-only. Treat adapter fidelity and equivalent_agent_resume as authoritative; do not infer hidden agent state preservation from an import command.
when_to_use: Use before handing a Wardwright trace to OpenCode, Codex, Claude, or another agent runner.

description: Export a recorded full-session trace as a reviewable artifact for an external agent harness.
name: export_agent_harness_trace
safety: Read-only unless the caller asks the UI/backend to save files. Exported artifacts can include sensitive trace metadata; equivalent resume is false unless the adapter explicitly says true.
when_to_use: Use after loading a trace when an agent should inspect or continue from the recorded evidence outside the Wardwright UI.

description: Export pinned scenario records as a deterministic regression pack or generated ExUnit source for native regression review.
name: export_regression_pack
safety: Read-only, but exported content can include scenario details the user should review before publishing.
when_to_use: Use when turning reviewed simulator cases into tests or sharing a minimal behavior pack.

description: Prune oldest unpinned scenario records for a policy pattern while always preserving pinned regression scenarios.
name: apply_scenario_retention
safety: Write-capable. Deletes unpinned scenario records only; pinned regression scenarios are preserved.
when_to_use: Use to keep local simulator evidence small after pinning the scenarios that matter.

description: Validate the current or submitted policy artifact for structural errors, opaque regions, missing scenario coverage, and unsupported provider stream capabilities.
name: validate_policy_artifact
safety: Read-only. Validation reports errors and review gaps; it does not replace human approval.
when_to_use: Use after every draft or proposed change and before asking the user to activate a model.
